# SSH key

The behaviors that sshkey calls, and each call that its examples make.
`osapi behavior chain get --name sshkey` shows the same.

## Chain

|          |                                                  |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| Behavior | [sshkey](../behaviors/security/sshkey/sshkey.md) |
| Chain    | sshkey → user                                    |
| Calls    | [user](../behaviors/security/user/user.md)       |
| Used by  | none                                             |

## A user with keys (list)

| CALL        | SENDS          | GETS                                                                         |
| ----------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| sshkey list | name=osapitest | \[&#123;"type":"ssh-ed25519","fingerprint":"SHA256:mnpIO1El26FsWnOeLzppADcN… |
| └─ user get | name=osapitest | gid=1001 home=/home/osapitest locked=true name=osapitest shell=/bin/s…       |

| └─ user get | name=osapitest | gid=1001 home=/home/osapitest locked=true name=osapitest shell=/bin/s… |
